partnerBlurb: Better Bridge is a nonprofit offering free personal finance and small business education, a free budgeting app, and free Playbook textbooks for community programs.
Better Bridge pledges that 100% of donations go to building its free app, printing free textbooks, and outreach.
legalLine: Better Bridge is a DBA of Bridge to Better Living Financial Advocacy Group Inc., a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, EIN 33-3035880.
